name: Batch Content Sync
description: Pushes and receives full content entities (nodes with nested media, paragraphs, taxonomy and files) between Drupal environments over custom REST endpoints, driven by a Batch API run and a shared access token.
project_description: Batch Content Sync is a lightweight Drupal 10/11 module for pushing content — nodes together with their referenced media, paragraphs, taxonomy terms and files — from one environment to another (QA, Stage, Prod) using custom REST endpoints. Editors select nodes on the content overview page and run one of three VBO-style actions (Push to QA/Stage/Prod); each pushed node is normalized (recursively, including base64-encoded file/image/media bytes and Layout Builder sections) and POSTed by a Batch API run to the configured target site, which runs the same module and re-creates or overrides the entity by UUID. Authentication is a single shared access token compared on the receiving controller; there are no contrib dependencies beyond core rest/serialization/node/file. Push and receive payloads are logged (with base64 truncated) to a custom database table viewable at an admin sync-log page.
